text: You say: "he buys the pullback once the ban lifts." That is the one entry my method forbids: I never buy the reaction itself, only the new high that proves it over (C5). structure_shift still reads RANGE, inside the swing, while KDP and WMT in the same group printed BULLISH_BOS; a stock failing to make new highs alongside its peers is grounds to revise (C14). mp 96.0 STRONG is my trend-column analogue, but DECELERATING says the push is slowing, not resuming. HOLD OPPOSE. One observable changes me: structure_shift turning BULLISH_BOS to join KDP and WMT. Cannot see: fill difficulty.
